releaseNote:
新增独立仪表盘，提供做题热力图、AC 高峰和最长用时统计，支持范围筛选及按日查看。兼容旧题目记录；超时未标记题目可经确认修改状态，用时保持 5:00:00+，始终归到创建日期。

Added a standalone Dashboard with activity heatmaps, peak AC and longest-time statistics, period filters, and daily views. Legacy records are supported. Overdue unmarked problems can be updated after confirmation while retaining their creation date and 5:00:00+ elapsed time.
